parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=8: 0.8193 -> 0.8077. Depth scaling remains very strong. Since agent-9 found success with WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 and agent-7/8 suggest MATRIX_LR=0.04 is superior, I will now try reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 and increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1 to optimize regularization for this high-capacity model.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 and increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1 on the current best DEPTH=8 architecture to optimize learning stability and regularization.
